summary: Studio Bagno is proud to bring Alice Ceramica’s vision to Australia. Located in the ancient heart of the Italian ceramic industry; Civita Castellana, Alice continues a centuries old tradition, cemented in a commitment to quality, design and creativity, producing some of the most beautiful bathware products in the world.
title: Meet Alice!
bodyHtml:
The Forefront of Italian Design

After an awe-inspiring R&D trip visiting our manufacturing partners in Italy, we are thrilled to introduce you to the creative forces behind some of our best-selling bathware.

Celebrating an 8-year partnership, this week we'd like you to meet Alice (pronounced 'alee-ché'), a trailblazer in Italian bathware design.

A Centuries Old Tradition

Nestled in the ancient heart of Civita Castellana, a hub of the centuries-old Italian ceramic industry, Alice is committed to preserving traditional artisan practices, enhanced by modern day mechanisation, to continue to push the boundaries of what's possible with ceramic bathware.

Alice Collections

Alice are the creators behind many of our flagship products, including the Nur Series, the Spy Series, the Form Series, and the striking new Lunaris Series.

Each collection showcases their dedication to innovation, creating bathroom products that are both refreshingly new yet timeless in aesthetic.

Breaking Limitations

At Alice the goal is clear: to enhance daily lives through exquisite design and impeccable manufacturing.

Their groundbreaking achievements, such as the 'Impossible' curve of the Nur Series, demonstrates Alice's leadership in hard-to-achieve ceramic design.
